title: Senior Engineer - Full Stack
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and operate web applications and services across our AI product portfolio. You will own features across the full application stack, from responsive user interfaces and frontend application logic to backend services, APIs, and databases.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and applied scientists, you will translate customer needs into secure, reliable, and intuitive software. This is a hands-on engineering role with responsibility throughout the development lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement in production.

Responsibilities

Deliver features end to end: Translate product requirements into technical designs and working software spanning the frontend, backend, and data layers.
Build modern user interfaces: Develop responsive, accessible web applications using a framework such as React, Angular, or Vue. Create reusable components and manage application state, API integration, and loading and error experiences.
Develop backend services and APIs: Design and maintain Python services using FastAPI or Flask, implementing business logic, validation, authentication, authorization, and integrations.
Design and manage application data: Develop database schemas, implement migrations, and optimize queries. Select appropriate SQL or NoSQL solutions based on application needs.
Integrate AI capabilities: Work with applied scientists to connect AI services and model APIs to usable product features, handling asynchronous operations, failures, and response times effectively.
Build quality into delivery: Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Participate in code reviews and maintain clear technical documentation.
Improve performance and reliability: Diagnose issues across browser, API, service, and database layers, addressing security, scalability, usability, and maintainability.
Support production operations: Collaborate with platform and DevOps teams on CI/CD, deployments, monitoring, and incident resolution. Take ownership of the production health of the features you deliver.
Contribute technical leadership: Guide implementation decisions, explain tradeoffs, mentor engineers, and improve shared engineering practices.

Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience delivering both frontend and backend components of production applications.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience in at least one modern frontend framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.
Practical understanding of component design, state management, responsive layouts, accessibility, and browser performance.
Strong backend development skills in Python, with experience using FastAPI, Flask, or a comparable framework.
Experience designing, implementing, and consuming RESTful APIs, including authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling.
Experience with relational databases, including data modeling, SQL, schema migrations, and query optimization.
Experience with automated testing across frontend and backend code, Git-based collaboration, and code reviews.
Familiarity with CI/CD, containerized applications, and deployment to cloud environments.
Ability to debug issues across the application stack and make practical tradeoffs between delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of taking ownership from requirements through production delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating AI/ML services or generative AI capabilities into applications.
Experience building SaaS products, including multi-tenant applications.
Familiarity with GraphQL, WebSockets, background processing, caching, or NoSQL databases.
Experience with additional backend technologies such as Node.js or Java.
Experience with mobile or cross-platform application development.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
